strings.analytics.tab.limits: What these numbers cannot tell you
strings.analytics.hidden: Only the club's own staff sees this report.
strings.analytics.strength.caption: Strength in points per game against an average team, {season} season. Public estimate: it can be wrong about a team the way a power rating is.
strings.analytics.strength.empty: No strength table yet: fewer than two teams in this competition.
strings.analytics.chart.caption: Fourth down in a neutral game state: rows are yards to go, columns are the yard line. G go, K field goal, P punt. Shaded cells are a coach's call (edge under 1 point or inside the error).
strings.analytics.delivery.late: The analysts have not finished it this week; it will arrive late.
strings.analytics.delivery.user_builds: No analyst on staff: build it yourself from the query screens.
strings.analytics.two.caption: Try choice by your lead after the touchdown and the time left.
strings.analytics.tracking.caption: Yesterday's load and the 7-day against 28-day ratio. Flags: under 0.8 underloaded, over 1.3 spike.
strings.analytics.tracking.check: Check on him: top speed down two straight games.
strings.analytics.tracking.practiceOnly: Practice tracking only: no game tracking at this program.
strings.analytics.staff.caption: Who builds this week's reports: {n} analyst seats filled.
strings.limits.averages_not_matchup: The model knows league averages, not this play's matchup, unless the staff ran the matchup search.
strings.limits.hidden_injuries: It does not know injuries hidden from the report.
strings.limits.fatigue: It does not know fatigue in the fourth quarter.
strings.limits.film_only: It does not know what the opponent has shown only on film.
